label: AusTender
terms_note: Public government RSS, no key, no stated limit; lodging a response requires an AusTender account and is done in the portal.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public RSS only) Confidence high (feed opened; Help pages 404).
auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: item title (ATM id: title), link → /Atm/Show/<guid>, description (HTML), pubDate
closing date, agency, category — not machine-readable

reference.limits: - Public data, no key, no limit stated. Lodging a response needs an AusTender account (portal only). - docs_url in the registry (https://www.tenders.gov.au/Help) is a 404 — point it at the RSS.

reason: The runtime can now parse the RSS 2.0 feed (https://www.tenders.gov.au/public_data/rss/rss.xml, 'AusTender Current ATM List'), but on 2026-09-25 the site's firewall answered HTTP 403 to every non-browser client: User-Agents 'platform-mcp/0.1', 'python-httpx/0.27', 'Feedly/1.0', 'Mozilla/5.0' and 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)' were all refused and only a full desktop-browser User-Agent string was answered. Serving it would require impersonating a browser. The JSON OCDS API (api.tenders.gov.au/ocds) returns awarded contract notices, not open tenders, and has no keyword search. Missing: an AusTender feed endpoint that accepts an honest API client User-Agent.
